name: U. H. Zaveri Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2017, U.H.Zaveri Ltd does trading of precious metals and jewelry
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company sells custom items created by its own bench jeweler and also seasonal collections from other jewelry brands. Company's operations are divided into 2 divisions: wholesale trading and retailing of jewelry through only retail showroom located in Ahmedabad. Company sells gold and silver jewelry, along with utensils. Jewelry is manufactured through job workers and is either designed in house or through 3-D jewelry designer

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Promoter holding has increased by 13.0% over last quarter.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.36% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -24.5%
